# Spotify sub-actions

## Add song to Spotify queue

Puts a song in your Spotify queue, so it plays after the current one. Made for a !sr command. Runs "Added" when it worked and "Not added" (with %spotify.error%) when it did not.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Song** | A song name to search for, like "bohemian rhapsody queen", or a Spotify song link. The default %rawInput% is what a viewer typed after the command. Starts as: `%rawInput%`. |

Paths it can take: **Added**, **Not added**.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%spotify.added%` | True when the song was added, False when not |
| `%spotify.title%` | The name of the song that was added |
| `%spotify.artist%` | Who sings or plays it |
| `%spotify.album%` | The album the song is on |
| `%spotify.link%` | A web link to the song, handy to post in chat |
| `%spotify.uri%` | Spotify's own code for the song (spotify:track:…) |
| `%spotify.error%` | Why it did not work, in plain words, like "Open Spotify on a device first…". Send it in chat from the "Not added" branch. |

<small>Type id: `spotify.addToQueue`</small>

## Pause / resume

Pauses Spotify, or makes it play again. Handy for a hotkey or a Stream Deck button. Needs Spotify Premium.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Do** | Pause, Resume (play again), or switch: pause if it plays and play if it is paused. Options: Pause if playing, play if paused, Pause, Resume. Starts as: `Pause if playing, play if paused`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%spotify.playing%` | True when Spotify plays afterwards, False when it is paused |

<small>Type id: `spotify.playPause`</small>

## Previous song

Goes back to the previous song on Spotify. Needs Spotify Premium and Spotify open on a device.

<small>Type id: `spotify.previous`</small>

## Set volume

Changes the volume of the device Spotify plays on. Some devices, like many phones, do not allow it. Needs Spotify Premium.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Volume (0-100)** | The new volume from 0 (silent) to 100 (loudest), like 40. You can use a variable such as %rawInput%. Starts as: `50`. |

<small>Type id: `spotify.setVolume`</small>

## Skip song

Skips to the next song on Spotify. Needs Spotify Premium and Spotify open on a device.

<small>Type id: `spotify.skip`</small>
